fullTitle: International Classification of Sleep Disorders, Third Edition, Text Revision
brptReferenceStatus: BRPT currently lists International Classification of Sleep Disorders, 3rd edition among RPSGT recommended readings; current AASM diagnostic authority is ICSD-3-TR (2023).
authorityBoundary: Use ICSD-3-TR for current sleep-disorder classification, terminology, and diagnostic-criteria context. It is not a substitute for the current AASM Scoring Manual when the question asks how to score a PSG event, nor for a current treatment guideline when treatment recommendations are the controlling issue.

libraryAvailability.olderFullTextBoundary: The library full-text copy is ICSD-3 and must not be represented as the 2023 ICSD-3-TR current text.

mappingRationale.D1A: The current BRPT blueprint explicitly includes sleep disorders in patient information and clinical assessment; ICSD-3-TR is the current AASM diagnostic classification source.

copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, public category names, the public table of contents, public diagnostic-change summaries, exact public-supplement page locators, and independently authored SPG learning objectives. Do not reproduce proprietary diagnostic text or substantial protected passages from the ICSD.
